lessons.lesson: padauk-gemma at temp=0.2 produces 98.9% Myanmar ratio and 96/100 fluency but cannot maintain character-epithet consistency across chunks without glossary injection. 'Weasel' rendered as 3 different animals, name bar had 2 variants. Glossary enforcement in translator.py is advisory (text block) not structural (term table). RAG with human pairs would anchor consistent style.
lessons.action: Enable RAG before multi-chapter runs. Add recurring epithets/nicknames to glossary. Postprocessor auto-correct known name variants. Current chunk_size 1500 may be too large — 1200 recommended for padauk-gemma.

lessons.lesson: Large sections of cn_mm_rules.py / en_mm_rules.py structured dicts (VOCABULARY_PRECISION, CULTURAL_RULES, CONFRONTATION_SPEECH_PATTERN) were dead code — imported but never read at runtime. The cultural_injector.py now bridges them. Always verify that structured data dicts are actually consumed at runtime, not just imported.
lessons.action: Run grep for dict imports vs dict .get() calls at runtime. Any dict that's only imported but never .get()-ed in production code is dead.

lessons.lesson: FastTranslator and FastRefiner were created as optimized alternatives but never wired into orchestrator. The Translator class directly handles both normal and fast paths. Avoid creating 'alternative' classes that aren't wired into the pipeline.
lessons.action: Single Translator/Refiner class with config-driven behavior is sufficient.

lessons.lesson: PivotTranslator (CN→EN→MM) was built but the pipeline uses settings.pivot.yaml with two Translator calls, not the PivotTranslator class. The two-stage pivot is a pipeline configuration, not a separate agent.
lessons.action: Pivot translation = two sequential Translator calls with different configs. No separate agent class needed.

lessons.lesson: RAG is wired into the codebase (rag_retriever, feedback_loop, ChromaDB) but OFF by default (config rag: {}). It works when enabled.
lessons.action: RAG is available. Document how to enable it in settings.yaml (rag.enabled: true).

lessons.lesson: A whole RAG pipeline can be silently dead: ChromaDB empty + a scale-mismatched filter meant the 1315-chapter human corpus never reached the model. Verify retrieval returns rows end-to-end, not just that ingestion 'ran'.
lessons.action: After any RAG change, assert retrieve_similar() returns >0 expected rows.

lessons.lesson: category column was free-text (no CHECK), so richer categories needed no migration — only subtype (additive column) + a relationship edge table did. Check column constraints before assuming a migration is required.
lessons.action: PRAGMA table_info + look for CHECK before planning schema work.

lessons.lesson: Making MemoryManager auto-seed 157 global terms on every init perturbed count/parity tests and exposed a test that wrote to the REAL default DB. Gate new always-on startup behavior behind a flag (auto_seed_global) so tests can opt out.
lessons.action: New startup side-effects get a default-on flag; tests pass it False and use isolated db_path.

lessons.lesson: External AI review (deepseek) flagged 10 issues; 2 were false positives (rapidfuzz 'missing' though in requirements; a deliberate heuristic) and 1 mischaracterized a no-op as a crash. Always verify each finding against the actual code before fixing.
lessons.action: Triage every external-review finding; reproduce before fixing; record rejected ones.

known_patterns.pattern: Dead code accumulates in structured rule dicts and unused agent classes
known_patterns.cause: Rules are written as structured data but never connected to the runtime code path
known_patterns.fix: Use cultural_injector.py pattern: import dicts at module level, match at runtime in a single function call

known_patterns.pattern: Async/sync replacement classes left as dead files
known_patterns.cause: Developer creates new implementation (FastTranslator) but leaves old code path unchanged
known_patterns.fix: Either wire the new class into the pipeline or delete it. Dead files confuse maintainers.
